candidates.title: Philippines - Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution
candidates.summary: Exercise increased caution in the Philippines due to crime , terrorism , unrest , and kidnapping . Some areas have increased risk. Read the entire Travel Advisory. Exercise increased caution due to terrorism and unrest associated with ongoing insurgent activities in certain rural and remote regions of Leyte , Mindoro , Negros , and Samar . Foreign terrorist organizations actively recruit Americans
